evidence.quoted_text:
require(baseline["count"] == len(after_recovery["repair_completions"]),
            "activation recovery produced a completion after the settled fence")
    require(baseline["invocations"] == [
        item.get("invocation")
        for item in after_recovery["repair_completions"]],
        "activation recovery completion log is not the baseline prefix")
evidence.reason: The assertions take `baseline` from the same `recover` call and compare it only with the post-recovery snapshot. A recovery that rewrites an existing completion entry while preserving the count and invocation values would pass; the pre-recovery log is never required to remain a prefix. The repeat check likewise compares only counts. This leaves the intended append-only completion-log invariant unenforced, so the finding identifies a real defect in the existing validation logic.
